items.title: Darnell Howard Interview, 1957-04-21
items.q: Tommy Dorsey, no, Tommy Dorsey wasn't known then. Jimmy Dorsey, Hoffman, a violin player, and the Mountain City Blue Boys.

ctx.x: Mm-hmm. And that bandstand had a little tear, you know, about four steps coming up to it. Tommy Dorsey, no, Tommy Dorsey wasn't known then. Jimmy Dorsey, Hoffman, a violin player, and the Mountain City Blue Boys. Yeah. We used to get off the bandstand and let them have it. Yeah, man, it knocked us out. How long did you play with Louis? How long?
